payload.summary: Roster has no double-booking check on a doctor's own shifts at import or manual add
payload.detail: src/lib/roster/shifts (diffRoster reconciles by sourceUid then perthDate|title and never checks that two kept rows overlap; addManualShifts inserts without a check). Team-side eligibility already detects clashes (team/eligibility.ts). Next action: detectOwnConflicts(shifts) as a non-blocking warning at import review and server-side, strict interval overlap not adjacency.
